translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Yave, ngeyo wuba buangu kieto kivuanda
mu tsungi ka tsungi.
Tuamina miongo mibutuka
voti tuamina wuvanga ntoto ayi nza ;
tona mu thangu ka thangu, ngeyo widi Nzambi.
Ngeyo wumvutulanga batu mu fundu-fundu
bu weti tuba :
“Vutuka mu fundu-fundu, e e bana ba batu.”
Bila va meso maku mili di mimvu midedikini
banga lumbu kimosi kiviokidi zono ;
voti banga thangu yimosi va builu,
ngeyo weti botula batu mu tulu tu lufua,
badi banga biti bimona va nsuka.
Va nsuka bimenini bimona,
va masika bilebukidi ayi biyumini.
Tulembo lalakana mu diambu di nganzi aku
ayi tsisi tulembo moni
mu diambu di miangu miaku.
Ngeyo wutudidi mambimbi meto va ntualꞌaku,
masumu meto masuama
va ntuala kiezila ki zizi kiaku.
Bilumbu bieto bioso bilembo mani
ku tsi nganzi aku ;
tulembo manisa mimvu mieto ayi luniongo.
Tezo ki bilumbu bieto kidi ki lusambudi lumimvu
voti lunana enati ngolo zidi yeto.
Sina kiawu kidi kaki kiphasi ayi kimianga.
Bila luzingu lueti lulembo vioki nsualu
ayi tulembo yendi.
Nani zebi lulendo lu nganzi aku e ?
Muingi miangu miaku miba tola banga lukinzu lolo fueni tambula.
Wutulongisa tanga bilumbu bieto mu bufuana
muingi tubaka ntima wu duenga.
Bika buela fuema, a Yave.
Nate thangu mbi mela bela e ?
Bika wumona bisadi biaku kiadi.
Mu nsuka, bika wutuyukutisa mu luzolo luaku lu ngolo ;
buna tuela yimbilanga mu khini ayi buna tuela yangalala
mu bilumbu bioso.
Wutuyangidikanga boso buididi bilumbu biobi wutumonisina phasi
boso buididi mimvu miomi tuyamusunu.
Bika mavanga maku mamonoso kuidi bisadi biaku ;
kiezila kiaku kuidi bana bawu.
Bika nlemvo wu Yave, Nzambi eto wubanga va beto,
bika mu diambu dieto, wukindisa kisalu ki mioko mieto.
Nyinga, kindisa kisalu ki mioko mieto.
